evidence.text: Test fresh matched specimens in both flow directions and counterbalance the order. The Saffire-I directions were tested in sequence on one specimen.
The rover fan selects the opposed orbital reference. The cabin model applies its measured speed to the strip.
Compare how far the front travels and how much oxygen is left. The cabin calculation starts with the speed you give it.

evidence.label: Native flight-test design limitation and experimental control
evidence.text: Discriminating test. Repeat both directions on fresh, matched specimens and counterbalance run order. Hold oxygen, pressure, geometry and airflow magnitude fixed. Compare calibrated front position over time and record remaining fuel. This separates a direction effect from possible prior heating or changes to the shared specimen.
